description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named CodeOutputCard. The widget displays generated code within a styled, scrollable container with action buttons for copying the code to the clipboard and sharing. It is designed for use within a Flutter app interface to show code outputs with user interactions.

classes.name: CodeOutputCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a styled code block with header actions for copying and sharing the code. It accepts the code text and an optional share callback.

methods.name: _copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the provided code string to the system clipboard and displays a confirmation SnackBar.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, including the header with icons and the scrollable code display area.
